messages:
harper: quick postmortem follow-up for GPU saturation incident. boiled down to 5 action items: soft-quota credits, scheduler pacer, nightly maintenance gating, headroom reserve proposal, and fallback telemetry + customer note. need owners + short deadlines.

zed: i'll take soft-quota credits (per-tenant "burst_credits"). thinking: 10% for 75s then stepped decay over 5m. RFC + tests by 2026-04-06.

lina: i'll run the scheduler pacer work (coalesce/window tuning + eviction damping). plan: replay baseline vs pacer=90ms, damping=4%. measurement in 48h, PR in ~10 business days.

omar: headroom reserve + cost calc here. initial idea: 3% static reserve + 7% ephemeral surge, drained over 8m. draft with sim CSV by 2026-03-31.

riley: i'll own telemetry + customer note. add `fallback_event_id` to tenant exports and a short template for affected tenant owners. PR by 2026-04-01.

infra-bot: Created issue infra/ops#1967 "burst_credits + scheduler-pacer" (assignee: zed).

harper: two constraints: 1) fallbacks must avoid cascading evictions; 2) nightly compaction at ~02:20 UTC correlates with spikes 9- can we gate it?

zed: for soft-quota i'll make the cushion ephemeral and require a cooldown before refill so we dont amplify sustained bursts. config + unit tests in the RFC.

lina: pacer numbers to test: coalesce_ms 50 -> 90, eviction_damping_pct 2 -> 5, preempt_delay_ms 250 -> 600. hypothesis: reduce multi-tenant evictions with <=8% p99 impact.

omar: gating plan: job-runner preflight check `global_headroom_pct >= 11` else delay randomized 1-6m. i'll coordinate with batch owners; add to headroom PR.

riley: telemetry: record every fallback + degraded_model flag (true/false). include event link in tenant notice. also add alert when a tenant has >2 fallbacks in 30m.

harper: short-term plan (1-2w): burst_credits (zed), pacer measurements (lina), headroom draft (omar), telemetry + template (riley). medium-term (3-6w): scheduler PR + automated degraded routing.

zed: deadlines: RFC + tests for burst_credits by 2026-04-06; gating coord by 2026-04-02.

lina: measurement plan: replay baseline + pacer=90ms. metrics = eviction_count, requeue_latency_ms, p99. target: eviction_count -30% with p99 delta <9%. results by 2026-03-29.

omar: headroom draft + cost estimate by 2026-03-31. will attach sim snapshots.

riley: telemetry + customer note PR by 2026-04-01. I'll add a short FAQ for tenants hit by degraded routing.

infra-bot: Reminder: issue infra/ops#1967 assigned to zed - due 2026-04-06.

harper: schedule a 15m weekly check for 6 weeks to monitor recurrence, rotate infra oncall. can someone add to calendar?

zed: added calendar entry "GPU capacity follow-ups" weekly 15m starting 2026-03-25 08:30 PDT. invite sent.

lina: quick note: observed backup job bursts at 02:15-02:25 UTC. gating + burst_credits together should cover most cases.

harper: great. i'll centralize owners & due dates in the incident ticket and close loop once PRs land. ping here when ready. :white_check_mark:
